name: Behringer XENYX 1002B Small Format Mixer With SKB Equipment/Mixer Bag /20'Cable 1002B A
description: The Behringer XENYX 1002B represents a significant milestone in the development of mixer technology. Equipped with the premium XENYX mic preamps, it can easily hold its own against the most expensive stand-alone mic preamps, both in terms of sound quality and available headroom. XENYx preamps offer a staggering 130 dB of dynamic range, with a bandwidth that extends from below 10 Hz to well above 200 kHz. XENYx mic pres provide such transparent, crystal-clear performance you just might think someone upgraded your mics.

name: Odyssey BR308 Rack Bag, 3-Space
description: Odyssey's unique rack bags allow you to remove the interior shell from the padded bag so you can stack racks firmly on top of each other without the lid getting in the way! All rack bags include a shoulder strap along with a small bag of rack screws and washers. The top pouch can store cables, microphones, or any other small gig essentials.
